question.text: The Instant Access Facility (IAF) for liquid fund redemptions by a resident individual investor is available up to a maximum of:

answer.text: Rs. 25,000 per day per scheme per investor
Rs. 50,000 or 90% of latest scheme value, whichever is lower, per day per scheme per investor
Rs. 1 lakh per day per scheme per investor
The full value of the investment with no limit

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-X-A (p.217) states the IAF limit as Rs. 50,000 or 90% of the latest value of the investment in the scheme, whichever is lower, per day per scheme per investor. The facility is available to resident individual investors in liquid funds. The Trap: The lower of the two figures applies, not the higher; and the percentage cap is on the latest scheme value, not on the original investment. Note: Suggestions to use liquid funds as a substitute for a savings account or for emergency funds are not in the checked IAF page and should be cited from a separate source before being asserted.
